label: late original-phase steps (sparse, mostly sequences starting with o) on v/t/e/d/1/2/r inputs
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.016% of steps). It fires only in the late original phase (t=4..9, peak orig_idx 5-7, mostly the last 1-3 tokens before <DEL>) and sometimes on the <DEL> step. It never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. Inputs are concentrated on v, t, e, d, 1, 2, r, and 64% of activation mass is in sequences whose first token is o (18.6x lift). It is also enriched for preceding tokens 1/f/z/p and two-back z/p/b/3/j, and for first occurrences of the input token. All of these are only enrichments: conjunctions of them reach at most about 19% precision (F1 at most about 0.22), so the feature looks like a diffuse hidden-state conjunction with no clean token-level description. Magnitude is highest for o-initial sequences at t=5-7 on t/v/e inputs. It does not fire on the copy phase.
